title: Nine Panels of Ink
subtitle: 卡通与动画 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 卡通与动画（文学艺术与体育·动画与漫画）
meta: 主题语境：卡通与动画（文学艺术与体育·动画与漫画）　|　核心词汇：cartoon　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cartoon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my mother was sent to draw ① a cartoon she could not finish, and she said the finishing was the whole of the lesson. The ② cartoon, meaning the drawing and not the joke, was nine panels long and was drawn by whoever came last; a cartoon, she said, is the only thing in a paper that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cartoon in that paper had the same border, and the ④ cartoon at the back, meaning the one the editor kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever drawn properly. A cartoon, my grandmother said, is nine parts ink and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the ink is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cartoon was the whole of the joke, meaning the laugh it carried and not the drawing. The ⑥ cartoon, meaning the joke and not any of that, is the only thing in a newspaper that everybody cuts out and nobody questions; a cartoon, he said, is either something you draw or the only word that means both a drawing and a joke. She said the joke is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ cartoon had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the border. The ⑧ cartoon of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine panels and eleven years of drawing; a cartoon, she said, is either the one at the back or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cartoon I remember is the one at the back, which was framed in 1977 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ cartoon, my grandmother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being laughed at; every cartoon, she said, is a joke that has agreed to look like a drawing. She said the joke was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 漫画；卡通；动画片
B. n. 漫画（指那幅画本身，与笑话相对）
C. 固定搭配：draw a cartoon 画一幅漫画
D. n. 漫画（指报纸上每一幅）
E. n. 漫画（指末尾那一幅）
F. n. 漫画（抽象：它承载的那个笑话）
G. n. 那个笑话（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a cartoon she could not finish
The cartoon, meaning the drawing and not the joke
cartoon was the whole of the joke
the cartoon had become a photograph in a report
The cartoon of the whole thing
A cartoon, my grandmother said in 1982

answers.why: draw a cartoon 意为“画一幅漫画”，1956 年母亲被派去画一幅她画不完的漫画。
cartoon 意为“漫画”，指那幅画本身而不是笑话，共九格，由最后走的人画成。
cartoon 指报纸上每一幅漫画，每一幅都是同样的边框。
cartoon 指末尾那一幅（编辑留的那一幅），是唯一有人认真画完的。
cartoon 意为“漫画”，抽象指它承载的那个笑话，父亲说 cartoon 就是那个笑话的全部。
cartoon 为抽象用法，指那个笑话本身，是报纸上人人都剪下来、却没人质疑的东西。
cartoon 意为“漫画、卡通”，到 1972 年这幅 cartoon 成了报告里的一张照片。
cartoon 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九格和十一年的作画。
cartoon 意为“漫画”，我记得的是末尾那一幅，1977 年装框，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
cartoon 为抽象总称，祖母说漫画是唯一会因为有人看了发笑而变好的东西。
